decisions.reason: Weekly reassessment. The cloud-sandbox docs URL now returns "About local sandboxing" (hash changed from c184ff4e… to 1ba8874…). It only briefly describes cloud sandboxing. The billing page confirms usage billing. No lifecycle stage, eligibility, policy, audit, data, or network control was fetched. All gates stay unknown. No human date is renewed.

citations.quote: Cloud sandboxing : Run an entire Copilot session remotely, inside a fully isolated, ephemeral Linux environment hosted by GitHub. Cloud sandboxing is billed based on usage.
Billing applies to cloud sandboxing only. Local sandboxing is included in the standard GitHub Copilot seat at no additional cost.
